title: S4 repair triage: split S3 findings into bounded repair packets for their owners
objective: Turn the S3 results into one repair round: a bounded repair packet per claim-critical finding, owned by the seat that owns the code, preserving the original first-sight score.
problem: Plan s2 S4: exactly one repair round; preserve the original score; rerun frozen regressions; unresolved claim-critical cases suspend that claim. Triage classifies each S3 finding: claim-critical defect (repair), contract defect (versioned amendment, escalate to the operator if it changes meaning), out of model (C3 list), equivalent (reviewer adjudication).
non_goals: No second repair round inside this slice
No change to the S3 record
evidence_required: repair packets created with owners and acceptance; the S3 score copied unchanged into the S4 record

acceptance.condition: every S3 finding has a disposition; repair packets READY
